errors: Typo in the typescript: 'diviseur de Cortier' should be 'diviseur de Cartier'.

Without the word 'arithmétique' (apparently Grothendieck's correction, marked 'G?'), the definition would be wrong: the nodal and cuspidal fibres have geometric genus 0. With the correction the statement is correct.

deep.surprise_reason: This is an archive copy of Deligne's published formulary (LNM 476). The only Grothendieck-specific content is a minor marginal correction (adding 'arithmétique') and a bibliographic note. There is no new mathematics.
transcription_corrections: The handwritten top-right note likely reads 'Pour une version un brin plus complète', not 'un bien plus complète'.
'voir aussi' in the transcription is probably 'see also' in the handwriting (or an abbreviation); the meaning is unchanged.
'Lecture Notes 476 (Anvers IV) p53-73' is correct and refers to Modular Functions of One Variable IV.
The 'G?' marginal mark sits next to the underlined word 'arithmétique', indicating Grothendieck's correction there.
